relationships.subject: chronic constriction injury
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI significantly reduced the binding of ESRRG to the Kcnn1 promoter, as evidenced by a 55% decrease in binding density in the ipsilateral L3/4 DRGs on day 7 after CCI, compared with the sham group (Figure 7A).

relationships.subject: KCNN1
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, our data suggest that, in the absence of nerve injury, downregulation of KCNN1 in the DRG leads to neuropathic pain-like symptoms.

key_findings: Nerve injury reduces DRG ESRRG binding to the Kcnn1 promoter, downregulating KCNN1, which lowers AHP/Kv currents and raises excitability.
DRG KCNN1 rescue prevents and reverses CCI nociceptive hypersensitivity; its knockdown in naive mice causes pain-like behavior.
